links.outcome: Readability of original discharge summaries versus LLM-simplified versions
links.effect: LLM summaries significantly more readable than originals across all three metrics (p < 0.0001), reaching a 10th-grade readability level; originals were too complex for patients.
links.quote: LLM-generated summaries from both prompting approaches are significantly more readable compared to the original summaries across all metrics (p < 0.0001).

unlisted_practices: LLM simplification of discharge summaries into patient-friendly language
LLM-generated personalized lifestyle recommendations added to discharge summaries

screen.reason: Empirical offline study evaluating GPT-4o to simplify cardiology discharge summaries and generate lifestyle recommendations, comparing two prompting strategies (full-text vs segment-wise) and evaluated by medical experts.
